name: Fleeting Day
source:
A visual novel where you get to play as Karamatsu! You can make many different choices and meet many different characters. Enjoy your day as this painful man.

I'm sure nothing bad will happen!

[From [url=https://stormoftara.itch.io/fleeting-day-a-karamatsu-visual-novel] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部让你扮演空松的视觉小说！你可以做出许多不同选择，遇见许多不同角色。享受这个痛苦男人的一天吧。

我相信什么坏事都不会发生！

（来源：[url=https://stormoftara.itch.io/fleeting-day-a-karamatsu-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]）
